scheme_name: Altiva Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
fund_name: Altiva Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
category: Hybrid Investment Strategies - Active Asset Allocator Long-Short Fund
scheme_objective:
The investment objective of the strategy is to generate long-term capital
appreciation along with income generation by dynamically investing across
equity, debt, equity and debt derivatives, InvITs, and commodity
derivatives, while also taking limited short exposure to permitted
instruments through derivatives
There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Investment
strategy will be achieved.

-If the units are redeemed/switched out after 30 days from the date of
allotment – Nil

changes will become effective prospectively from the date such changes are
